name: Cloud SCADA and remote operations centres
principle: Cloud and hybrid SCADA moves the historian, dashboards and supervisory applications to managed cloud infrastructure while keeping the local control loop deterministic at the edge — PLCs and RTUs keep control during outages and push data up through brokers such as OPC UA. A remote operations centre then pools specialists across sites: one control-room team supervises many facilities, surveillance and analytics run plant-wide, and cybersecurity follows IEC 62443 zoning between the operational network and the cloud layer.

process_steps.name: Edge devices keep local control and buffer data during outages
OPC UA brokers push telemetry to the cloud layer
Cloud historian, dashboards and analytics serve all sites
Remote operations centre supervises facilities from one room
IEC 62443 zones and conduits separate operational from cloud networks
